name: Mori Ranmaru
source:
A handsome stoic youth who hides his enthusiasm.
A close associate of Nobunaga who has served him since he was young.
He faces people who would cause harm with no hesitation, he's always alert for danger when in the castle.
He always unshirkingly puts in the utmost effort to be a suitable for his lord.
